items.title: 43 Times People Were Humbled By Their Own Old Posts (New Pics)
items.summary:
Posting online feels like talking into the wind, and sometimes even a little cathartic. That is right up until someone produces the recording. Your past self has been sitting in the archive since 2012, waiting for the exact moment you announce a brand new opinion with unadulterated confidence. Then the reply arrives: "Is that you?" complete with the smoking gun, a screenshot . 

Most of us only have to bear the shame of embarrassing emo selfies or Tweets about being on the toilet, but many politically inclined have more to answer for. They lectured the comment section on a position their own timeline had already demolished years earlier, and luckily for us, somebody scrolled back far enough to find it. Enjoy the irony , and maybe check your own old posts while you're at it.

#1 The T In Cto Stands For Tequila © Photo: dkarlovi 

#2 Double "This You" © Photo: FluxD1 

#3 Ah Yes, The Double Standards Of Blaire White Back Again © Photo: CeleneDreamveil 

Most people who get an "Is that you?" reply aren't lying when they insist they've always believed what they're saying now. Their memory has been wired to edit itself. In 1973, psychologists George Goethals and Richard Reckman measured students' opinions on school busing, then put them in group discussions where planted participants argued the opposite side. 

Many students changed their minds. When asked to recall what they had originally thought, they remembered their old views as much closer to their new ones than they actually were. Their brains rewrote the draft and deleted the evidence, but these days a screenshot is…
items.t: 43 Times People Were Humbled By Their Own Old Posts (New Pics)

A sign only gets a couple of seconds of attention, so big letters, a clear color split and a short message are the unglamorous foundation under every memorable one. Even the silliest sign on this list had to pass that test first, otherwise nobody would have stopped long enough to take the photo.

Later, after getting drunk and starting a snowball fight, Malcolm said his mother and her sisters decided to gang up on their “evil” stepmother. Whatever happened…

Lawrence’s photos kickstarted a fresh wave of plastic surgery speculation , with many claiming she has “ruined” her face with an upper blepharoplasty (eyelid surgery) and a brow lift.

“Another woman lost to the surgeon’s knife,” one disappointed user commented.

Cosmetic surgery experts have since shared theories about the factors behind Lawrence’s facial transformation.

A plastic surgeon theorized that Jennifer Lawrence underwent a blepharoplasty and other procedures 

Jamie McCarthy/Getty Images 

Dr. Melinda Lacerna Kimbrell, a double board-certified plastic surgeon , agreed with the netizens.

“The most obvious procedural changes appear to be around her eyes,” she told the Daily Mail . “There is substantially more upper-lid visibility, less hooding, and elevation of the outer brow.”

“That pattern strongly suggests an upper blepharoplasty, possibly combined with a brow lift and a lateral eye lift,” Dr. Kimbrell said, adding that Lawrence may also have done selective fat grafting around the lower eyelid and upper cheek.

The person also explains that taking the children would involve more than just buying two additional tickets. There would also be expenses for lodging, food, and other necessities.

items.title: ‘By Law I Am Family’: TikToker Questions Mother-in-Law’s Decision to Exclude Her From Christmas After Sister-in-Law Shares a Different Story
items.summary:
TikTok user @spicy.bells posted a video about her mother-in-law uninviting her from the family’s Christmas celebration. According to the TikToker, her mother-in-law has never done anything like this before. At the time of publication, the post had garnered 237,100 views and 41 comments.

In the video, @spicy.bells says her mother-in-law told her husband that only blood-related family members were allowed to attend the celebration. However, she considers herself family because she is married to her husband.

“Every Christmas, my mother-in-law hosts everybody at their big family vacation home in Florida. Coincidentally, it’s also like the only time of year my husband and I get to go on a vacation,” she says.

She goes on to explain that they don’t get much time off, so they look forward to the trip every year. Not only does it give them an opportunity to take a vacation, but it also allows them to spend time with family.

However, she says her mother-in-law called her husband and told him that the trip was only for family, with no wives allowed.

According to @spicy.bells, her husband was understanding about the situation, and the two planned to visit her family instead. However, when she called her sister-in-law to catch up, she discovered something unexpected.

“She asks me what I’m planning on packing for Christmas vacation. I’m sorry, I was told that we weren’t invited. It was blood family only. She’s like, what do you mean? All the wives are going. Even boyfriends and girlfriends are going,” she recalls.

The TikToker says she is now waiting for her husband to come home…
items.t: ‘By Law I Am Family’: TikToker Questions Mother-in-Law’s Decision to Exclude Her From Christmas After Sister-in-Law Shares a Different Story

She wondered how embarrassing it would be if she had almost no one to invite from her side of the family and friends.
